contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Radiate, possibly of Postumus (260-269), Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust right. Obverse inscription: [--]O[--]MVS[--]. Reverse description: Standing female figure left, possibly Pax. Reverse inscription: [PAX] AVG. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 19.2mm, Weight: 2.05gms, die axis: 12
